quote: each step conditions on the previous state, and more parallel compute cannot shorten the chain's integrated autocorrelation time, only how fast samples accumulate.
reason: Identifies serial autocorrelation as a bottleneck parallelism cannot relieve; no reframe proposed, steps still run in order.

quote: after burn-in the N chains' joint density factorizes and they are independent, so the ensemble already splits into N chains run simultaneously
reason: Runs many independent chains simultaneously; that is side-by-side copies, which the criterion explicitly excludes.

quote: the workload decomposes into thousands of independent model runs that are embarrassingly parallel across chains and parameter sets
reason: Same forward model evaluated on many independent parameter sets and chains; more items, not removed step dependencies.

quote: each catchment is independently calibratable, so GPU/cloud throughput directly determines how many catchments get a proper Bayesian treatment
reason: Replicates the same per-catchment calibration across 671 independent catchments; side-by-side copies, each chain still serial.
